pairing: Adjacent releases share the same four channel seeds. Pattern 1,2,2,1 creates 500 one->two and 500 two->one matched pairs per run inside one persistent MPS/Qwen process.
configuration: One A100, MIG off, MPS 40% per NeuralRx endpoint and 20% Qwen, four cells, P180/D155, NRx45/conv12/AI50, Qwen prefill context16 batch1, GC off, no injected failure.
frozen_gates: Both runs require exact per-release count pattern, identical four PHY seeds inside every adjacent pair, 2,000 pre-observation Qwen units, and zero deadline/bound/guard/credit/fault violations. Separately for each run and each order stratum, the 10,000-resample paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound of two-minus-one pre-observation Qwen execution time must exceed zero. Any stratum failure remains negative. Timely-AI and correct-TB paired effects are reported but are not part of this mechanism gate. This is not a policy, actual AI-RAN application, or WCET result.
